notes.title: Regotown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290253/880539e32fdc4d2cb91ccbe3dc1037c0d17832ec.png[/img]
Hello, dear players!

I want to be completely honest with our still small community about the situation with Regotown.

Today we had to deal with an unexpected technical review from Steam. Technical support for the platform required a complete renaming and re-creation of the game page, which creates significant financial and organizational difficulties for our small team.

Despite the fact that the two previous versions of Bat of Dead remained in the package, we need to actually return everything to how it was. Unfortunately, we are currently unable to pay for a new Steam page for Regotown due to sanctions, which puts the future of Regotown in serious question.

We are sincerely upset by this situation and understand that this may cause disappointment to our loyal fans. We continue to look for solutions and hope for your understanding.

Thank you for your support! We do not give up and will never give up.

Respectfully,
GolGrot Team

notes.title: Regotown update
notes.content:
A huge update that has been in the works for so long.

We apologize if you encountered technical issues during the preparation of this update. We care about making your gaming experience as comfortable as possible.

Regotown and Bat of Dead (both versions) are now available to you all together.

You might ask, "Why is the game now called Regotown?" and I will respond, "Because you now get all three games, and this one is the biggest and coolest!!!"

Thank you for being here throughout the journey; creating the update to Regotown took way too long due to my issues.

Expect a full Regotown 2 much faster than this update, as there are now no obstacles on the path to the new game.

notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
All errors and wishes into account.
The final update will appear on March 31, 2021.
You are waiting for new locations offer large plot of content and many new secrets.
Improved graphics and animation.
This is the last spurt of the game.
The bat MUST FLY !!!

notes.title: Grand Update!
notes.content:
At the end of the month, there will be a huge update.
In fact, this is a completely different game.
Changes await you.
1) 70% of the graphic part is either redone or improved.
2) Other control mechanics.
3) More eerie atmosphere.
4) Are taken into account past mistakes, and now the plot less abstract.
5) Fixed stylistic flaws.

!!!ATTENTION!!!
The game has become much higher quality.
The game will rise in price immediately after the New Year's Eve weekend.
We are forced to do it and ask for forgiveness.
